definitions.explanation: The degree or quality of spicy or hot flavor in food. Refers to the burning sensation from chili peppers, wasabi, mustard, and similar ingredients.

examples.japanese: {辛|から}さを{調整|ちょうせい}できますか。
このカレーは{辛|から}さが{控|ひか}えめで{食|た}べやすい。
examples.english: This curry has mild spiciness and is easy to eat.

examples.japanese: {唐辛子|とうがらし}の{辛|から}さは{品種|ひんしゅ}によって{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なり、マイルドなものから{激辛|げきから}までさまざまだ。
examples.english: The spiciness of chili peppers varies greatly depending on the variety, ranging from mild to extremely hot.

notes:
The noun form of the adjective {辛|から}い (spicy/hot). Describes the quality or degree of spiciness in food. Formed by dropping the い ending and adding さ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辛|から}さを{調整|ちょうせい}する: to adjust the spiciness
- {辛|から}さ{控|ひか}えめ: mild spiciness
- {辛|から}さが{足|た}りない: not spicy enough
- {辛|から}さレベル: spiciness level

USAGE:
Restaurants often let customers choose their preferred {辛|から}さ level. Common scales include {甘口|あまくち} (mild), {中辛|ちゅうから} (medium), {辛口|からくち} (hot), and {激辛|げきから} (extremely hot).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {甘|あま}さ: sweetness — the noun form of {甘|あま}い
- {苦|にが}さ: bitterness — the noun form of {苦|にが}い
- {酸|す}っぱさ: sourness — the noun form of {酸|す}っぱい
